AssignmentHistory.description: Whether a Project has ever held a Node assignment, and how confidently that is known.

AssignmentIdentity.description: AssignmentIdentity names one assignment of one Project lifetime.

volume.description: Volume names a Managed volume declared in spec.volumes.

strategy.description: Strategy is how the volume is backed up.

retainFull.description:
RetainFull is how many full backups pgBackRest keeps, each with the
differential backups that depend on it. Only valid for
PostgresDifferential; DefaultRetainFull when omitted. It is a count, not
a time guarantee: extra full backups and failed runs change how far back
the retained backups reach.

BackupItem.description: BackupItem selects the backup strategy of one Managed volume.

BackupStrategy.description: How a Managed volume is backed up.

assignment.description: Assignment is the released assignment. Its Agent is the cleanup owner.

releasedAt.description: ReleasedAt is when the assignment was given up.

releaseAuthorization.description: ReleaseAuthorization is what permitted giving the assignment up.

resourcesRemoved.description:
ResourcesRemoved is the cleanup owner's evidence that every
deletion-scoped runtime resource it held for this assignment is gone.
Nil means the obligation is unresolved.

managedDataOwed.description:
ManagedDataOwed records that the Project moved away while declaring a
Managed volume, so this Node's local data has to leave the active path
(ADR-0024 C2) before the Node may hold the Project again. A deletion does
not set it: local Managed data is retained then.

managedDataQuarantined.description:
ManagedDataQuarantined is the cleanup owner's evidence that it did so. It
is separate from ResourcesRemoved because each can be true without the
other.

CleanupObligation.description: CleanupObligation is one released assignment whose Node may still hold the Project's runtime resources.

backupID.description: BackupID names the generation in the object store.

assignment.description: Assignment is the assignment that produced and committed it.

committedAt.description: CommittedAt is when the server accepted it.

CommittedBackup.description: CommittedBackup records one backup generation accepted as the restore source.

type.description: Type is a machine-readable identifier, e.g. "Ready", "Phase".

status.description: Status is one of True, False, Unknown.

lastHeartbeatTime.description: LastHeartbeatTime is when this condition was last sampled.

lastTransitionTime.description: LastTransitionTime is when the Status last changed.

reason.description: Reason is a CamelCase word summarising why the condition has this status.

Condition.description: Condition describes a single observable aspect of a resource's state.

valueFrom.description:
ValueFrom sources the value from another object instead of a literal.
The agent resolves it to a plain Value before the spec reaches the
container runtime; the Runtime layer never sees a ValueFrom.

EnvVar.description: EnvVar is a single environment variable to inject into a container.

EnvVarSource.description: EnvVarSource holds the possible indirect sources for an EnvVar value.

IngressAccess.description: IngressAccess defines visibility and auth rules for an ingress endpoint.

IngressDef.description: IngressDef describes a single HTTP ingress rule for a Project.

IngressScope.description: Controls whether a route is exposed to the public internet or only to the Headscale overlay network.

IngressTarget.description: IngressTarget is the backend service and port for an ingress rule.

ManagedDataQuarantinedEvidence.description: ManagedDataQuarantinedEvidence records when the cleanup owner of an obligation moved its local Managed data out of the active path, or found none there.

name.description: Name is the unique identifier within its Kind namespace.

uid.description:
UID is an immutable, server-generated identity assigned once when the
resource is first created. Unlike Name, it is never reused: deleting and
recreating a resource with the same Name yields a different UID. Runtime
ownership (e.g. Docker container labels) is fenced on UID so a delayed
request or a leftover container from a previous lifetime of the same Name
cannot be mistaken for the current resource. Clients cannot set or change
it; any client-supplied value is ignored by the server.

namespace.description:
Namespace scopes this resource within its Kind. 1.0 locks every write to
"" or "default" (enforced in ValidateNamespace); see api/v1/validation.go
for the removal pointer once namespaces open up post-1.0.

resourceVersion.description:
ResourceVersion is set by the server and incremented on every write. It
is currently a pure write-counter; optimistic-concurrency conflict
checking is a separate post-1.0 task.

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs used for selection and grouping.

annotations.description: Annotations are non-identifying metadata (e.g. human-readable hints).

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is set by the server on first write.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is set by the server on every write.

ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta holds identity and classification metadata common to all resources.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion identifies the versioned schema this resource conforms to, e.g. "caravanserai/v1".

kind.description: Kind is the resource type, e.g. "Node", "Project".

Project.title: Project
Project.description: Project is the central workload resource.

interval.description:
Interval is the time between backup runs, e.g. "168h", "1h". Parsed with
time.ParseDuration; must be positive.

onMissing.description:
OnMissing selects behaviour when no backup exists at restore time.
Defaults to InitializeEmpty when empty.

items.description:
Items selects a backup strategy per Managed volume. A Managed volume not
listed here uses BackupStrategyOffline. Items are fixed when the Project
is created: switching a live volume between strategies would leave two
backup histories for the same data, and nothing can yet choose between
them at restore time.

ProjectBackupConfig.description: ProjectBackupConfig configures periodic object-store backup of a Project's Managed volumes.

stanzas.description:
Stanzas lists every pgBackRest stanza this lifetime has created,
including those of volumes later removed from the spec. It only grows:
deleting a lifetime's backups has to find every stanza it ever wrote.

ProjectBackupStatus.description: ProjectBackupStatus is the backup state of one Project lifetime.

ProjectPhase.description: Lifecycle state of a Project as maintained by the Controller Manager.

rescheduleAttempts.description: RescheduleAttempts counts cross-Node reschedules in the current incident.

lastAttemptAt.description:
LastAttemptAt is when the most recent reschedule was attempted. Backoff
is computed from it.

healthySince.description:
HealthySince is when the Project was last seen continuously healthy. It
is meaningful only while HealthySinceGeneration equals the current
assignment generation: a window observed under an older assignment says
nothing about the current one.

healthySinceGeneration.description:
HealthySinceGeneration is the assignment generation HealthySince was
observed under.

preferredNode.description:
PreferredNode is a scheduler hint only. Status.NodeRef remains the
authoritative assignment.

workloadStopped.description:
WorkloadStopped is the durable no-start latch for one assignment
generation: the assigned Agent confirmed that every Project container is
stopped. It is not proof that runtime resources were removed, and it
alone never authorizes final deletion. Only a committed newer assignment
clears it; time alone does not.

cleanupObligations.description:
CleanupObligations lists every assignment this Project has given up
whose Node may still hold its runtime resources. An entry is appended in
the same write that releases an assignment or moves the Project to
Terminating, so the list is the complete set of Nodes that may still
hold resources. Final deletion requires every entry to be resolved.

committedBackup.description:
CommittedBackup is the generation a new placement restores from
(ADR-0024 C1). Only the assignment current at the time can set it, so once
an assignment is released its Agent can no longer change where the next
one restores from, even if it can still reach the object store. A new
assignment keeps it. Nil means no backup has ever been committed.

ProjectRecoveryStatus.description: ProjectRecoveryStatus is the structured recovery state of a Project.

ProjectSize.description: T-shirt size declaring the Project's resource footprint. Defaults to Medium when omitted.

size.description:
Size declares the Project's resource footprint for capacity-aware
placement. Omitting it means DefaultProjectSize; see EffectiveSize.

services.description: Services is the ordered list of containers to run.

volumes.description: Volumes are named storage units shared across services.

backup.description:
Backup configures periodic backup of every Managed volume in this
Project. Omitting it means the volumes persist on the node but are
never uploaded.

ingress.description: Ingress defines public or internal HTTP routing rules.

expireAt.description:
ExpireAt, when set, causes the GC controller to delete the Project
after this time. Useful for ephemeral preview environments.

ProjectSpec.description: ProjectSpec is the desired state declared by the user.

phase.description: Phase is the high-level lifecycle state.

nodeRef.description: NodeRef is the name of the Node the Scheduler chose. Empty while Pending.

assignmentGeneration.description:
AssignmentGeneration is a server-owned counter that increments by one on
every successful Pending-to-Scheduled assignment. Together with UID and
nodeRef it forms the fence an Agent must present on every write: a report
carrying an older generation is rejected as stale, which defeats the ABA
problem that UID and nodeRef alone cannot — a Project reassigned A→B→A
reuses the Node name but never a generation. Clearing nodeRef revokes the
current generation but does not reset the counter.

This is not a user manifest field; clients cannot set it.

assignmentHistory.description:
AssignmentHistory records whether this Project was ever assigned a Node,
gating whether it may be hard-deleted directly or must enter the cleanup
lifecycle first. Server-owned; not a user manifest field.

failedNodes.description:
FailedNodes names the Nodes this Project was moved off after it was
reported Failed, oldest first. The scheduler never places the Project on
one of them, so a move actually changes Node, and its length is how many
moves have been spent against the retry cap.

It is cleared when the Project has run on a new Node long enough to count
as recovered, and when the user applies the Project again.

Server-owned; not a user manifest field.

conditions.description: Conditions is a list of granular observable states.

recovery.description:
Recovery is the durable state of cross-Node recovery: retry bookkeeping
and the evidence that lets an assignment be released or a record be
deleted. It lives here rather than in Condition messages because it must
survive server restarts and duplicate controller events, and because code
must never recover a counter or an identity by parsing a message.

Server-owned; not a user manifest field. Nil until recovery first records
something.

backup.description:
Backup is the backup state of this Project lifetime. Server-owned: the
API resets it on create and only the assigned Agent's fenced reports
change it.

ProjectStatus.description: ProjectStatus is written by the Controller Manager and Agent.

ResourcesRemovedEvidence.description: ResourcesRemovedEvidence records when the cleanup owner of an obligation finished removing every deletion-scoped runtime resource it held.

key.description: Key selects one entry in the Secret's spec.data.

SecretKeySelector.description: SecretKeySelector points at a single key inside a named Secret.

name.description:
Name identifies the service within the Project (used as the DNS
hostname inside the shared bridge network).

image.description: Image is the Docker image reference, e.g. "postgres:15".

command.description:
Command overrides the image's CMD, as in Docker Compose; the image's
ENTRYPOINT still applies. Empty keeps the image's default.

env.description: Env are extra environment variables injected at runtime.

volumeMounts.description: VolumeMounts lists volumes to attach to this container.

ServiceDef.description: ServiceDef describes a single container (analogous to a Compose service).

StanzaRecord.description: StanzaRecord is one pgBackRest stanza a Project lifetime created.

type.description: Type determines lifecycle and backup semantics.

VolumeDef.description: VolumeDef describes a named volume used by one or more services.

VolumeMount.description: VolumeMount associates a named Volume with a container mount path.

VolumeOnMissing.description: What to do when a Managed volume has no backup at restore time.

VolumeType.description: Governs the lifecycle and backup behaviour of a Volume.

WorkloadStoppedEvidence.description: WorkloadStoppedEvidence records that the Agent of Assignment confirmed every Project container stopped.
